newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's fledgling OTC market surges to record.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's fledgling OTC market surges to record.

text.p: Taiwan's stock market sizzle shifted on Wednesday to the island's fledgling over-the-counter exchange, which bounded to new highs on surging financial sector prices, the exchange said.
The OTC index gained 10.18 points or 4.72 percent to notch a record 226.06-point close.
Daily turnover was a bullish T$10.20 billion, slightly shy of Monday's record T$10.42 billion, but nonetheless more than 11 percent of the Taiwan Stock Exchange's turnover on Wednesday.
Brokers confirmed that some liquidity had flowed in from the main exchange, which has consolidated for two days as its index encountered technical and psychological resistance at 7,000 points.
The Taiwan Stock Exchange weighted index closed a scant 0.07 percent or 5.19 points higher at 6,932.96 on Wednesday.

The over-the-counter exchange's turnover has rocketed since September 1995 when it pioneered a trading system requiring brokerages to pay only deposits to the exchange before trading, rather than paying for stocks in full at the time of purchase.
There are 71 firms listed in the new exchange, which has said it hopes to reach 100 listings by the end of 1996.
